Callout.Name: Vandalism at a Museum
Callout.Message: Display case damaged, staff reporting a suspect nearby.
Callout.Advisory: One male, no weapon, no items taken.

Script.Line: I put my hand on the case. That is all I did.
The case was cracked before I got there.
Ask the staff. There is a camera pointing right at it.

Lines.Approach: He put a display case through and walked off down the road. Nobody has taken anything.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
